finding.title: SOURCE87 task5 replaces the printed period after 200 with a comma
finding.literalBefore: 导线框的匝数 $n=200$，导线框在匀强磁场里以恒定的角速
finding.literalAfter: 导线框的匝数 $n=200$. 导线框在匀强磁场里以恒定的角速
finding.diagnosis: The original-only baseline already records a period and sentence break after 200. Both frozen author and current MD contain a Chinese comma instead. This is not the harmless fullwidth/ASCII normalization of the same punctuation mark.
finding.impact: Faithful source prose has a changed sentence boundary. Digits, equation structure and the physical row itself are otherwise present; this finding does not certify the n glyph's alphabet.
finding.origin: Present in the original author snapshot; not introduced by D239's MD-only copying.

permittedDelta: Replace only the comma after n=200 by the independently observed sentence-ending period; retain all other text, formulas, rows, metadata and boundaries.
